I can’t change your inbox because no email tools are available here. I can, however, guide you step‑by‑step to remove the 37 recruiting messages yourself — and help set up a filter so new ones don’t clutter your inbox.

Two quick questions before I give exact instructions:
1) Do you want to Archive (safe, recoverable) or Delete (moves to Trash; eventually permanently removed)? I recommend Archive unless you’re sure you want them gone.  
2) Which email provider/app do you use (Gmail web, Gmail mobile, Outlook web, Outlook desktop, Apple Mail, etc.)?

Below are concise general instructions you can use now. Tell me your choice (Archive/Delete) and provider and I’ll give exact steps.

General (works for most web email UIs)
- Find the messages: in the search box try keywords like recruit OR recruiting OR recruiter OR job OR “recruiting” (adjust to match how those messages appear).  
- Select all matching conversations: click the “select all” checkbox; if there’s a banner/link that says “Select all conversations that match this search,” click that to include all results.  
- Apply action: click Archive (usually a box/arrow icon or “Archive” button) or click Delete/Trash (trash icon). Note: deleting usually moves messages to Trash/Deleted Items first; in many services Trash is emptied automatically (Gmail: permanently deleted after ~30 days).

Create a filter to remove future recruiting messages (Gmail web example)
- Click Settings (gear) → See all settings → Filters and Blocked Addresses → Create new filter.  
- In the From/Subject/Has the words fields enter recruiter OR recruiting OR job (adjust as needed). Click Create filter.  
- Choose action: “Skip the Inbox (Archive it)” to archive automatically, or “Delete it” to send to Trash. Then Create filter.

If you use Outlook web or desktop, Apple Mail, or another provider I’ll give exact step‑by‑step instructions for that interface and a suggested search/filter expression to match those 37 messages. Also confirm Archive vs Delete so I include retention warnings and the precise clicks. Which do you want and which email service are you using?
